top_violation_types.title: Notification of Planned Closure (26 TAC §746.301(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed to not be providing care during the time of the inspection. They did not inform Child Care Regulation that they would be closed prior to the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection available.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not been documenting their monthly maintenance inspections.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver had seven students in care ages 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, and 22 months old. The operation was out of ratio by one student.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent inspection report was not posted.
